t: This is Haverstock Hill, a street in the London Borough of Camden. There isn't much recorded about the street itself, but a number of people have lived and died along it. The painter and muralist Mary Adshead died here. So did John Camden Hotten, a publisher and bibliophile. Louisa Browning, who ran a small school that had some notable pupils, died here too. And the writer Drusilla Beyfus, who became known for her books on modern manners and etiquette, was born here.
